title: Base change of the universal linear-system zero scheme
statement: Let k be a field, f:Y -> Spec k a scheme, L an invertible module and s_i finitely many global sections. Put P=A^I_k times_k Y and let J be the universal zero-scheme ideal of [def-zl-bertini-universal-family]. For any scheme X and g:X -> P, the comap J along g is the zero-scheme ideal of sum_i (g followed by pr_1)^*(x_i) times the canonical tensor-pullback unit of s_i along g followed by pr_2. All pullbacks and zero schemes use [def-pc-base-change] and [def-pc-zero-scheme]; the invertible module uses [def-sc-invertible-module]. Conventions: schemes and their residue fields [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions].

source.place: Situation 0G47, situation-family-divisors, universal divisor and its fibres

proof.text: Identify the canonical tensor pullback with the existing module pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints. Its unit maps to the existing pullback section. A module isomorphism carries homOfGlobalSection to the corresponding section morphism, so its zero scheme does not change.

The zero scheme commutes with module pullback. Transport through the comparison just constructed to express this using the canonical tensorSectionsUnit. Composition of the adjunctions gives the composition identity for these units.
The unit is additive and semilinear. Apply it to the universal sum, then use the composite-unit identity to identify the resulting coefficients and pulled-back sections with the displayed sum.

theorem bertiniUniversalIdeal_comap
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (L : Y.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (s : I → Γ(L, ⊤))
    (g : X ⟶ pullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C : k →+* MvPolynomial I k))) f) :
    (bertiniUniversalIdeal f L s).comap g =
      (homOfGlobalSection _ (∑ i,
        (g ≫ pullback.fst
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C : k →+* MvPolynomial I k))) f).appTop
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial I k))).inv (MvPolynomial.X i)) •
        tensorSectionsUnit (g ≫ pullback.snd
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C : k →+* MvPolynomial I k))) f)
          L (s i))).zeroLocus
